oneOf.description: Build a missing environment; leave an existing one alone at start, and under `muructl run` build when the lock changes.

Instrumentation.description: One instrumentation module of a release: a tool such as an import timer or an APM agent, imported before the application and set up apart from it, with settings that only it is given.

module.description: The module, as a dotted Python module name.

settings.description: The settings its `configure` function is given, as a table of any values.

when.description: When the environment is built before the application starts.

RunPort.description: A port of the run table: a number, or `auto` for a free one, as the `--port` and `--https-port` flags take it.

RunSettings.description: The `[tool.muru.run]` table of a pyproject.toml, or `[run]` in a muru.toml and in muru.local.toml: how `muructl run` serves this project, with a key for each flag of the command that describes the serving rather than the application. The daemon ignores it. Lists add across the layers, as a list flag adds to a key.

access_log.description: Which requests the access log writes: `on` (the default), `errors` or `off`.

access_log_exclude.description: Paths left out of the access log.

access_log_file.description: A file the access log's JSON lines go to in place of the terminal, relative to the project.

env_file.description: A `.env` file whose variables the run starts with, relative to the project. Its values override `[tool.muru.env]`. None is read unless this names one.

hosts.description: Names the development certificate covers besides localhost.

https_only.description: Serve HTTPS alone, HTTP redirecting to it.

reload_dirs.description: Directories watched, relative to the project; the project when empty.

reload_exclude.description: Patterns that never trigger a reload.

slow.description: How long a request may take before `errors` shows it.

timestamps.description: Whether every line on the terminal carries the full UTC time.

tls_cert.description: A certificate chain to serve, relative to the project.

tls_key.description: Its private key, relative to the project.

toolbar.description: Whether the edge inserts the development toolbar into the run's HTML pages.

description: muru.local.toml as a schema sees it: the `[run]` table, and the one key of `[build]` development reads. The file is parsed by [`crate::parse_local`], which takes the tables apart itself.

instrumentation.description: Instrumentation modules for this machine's runs, before the project's own.

run.description: How `muructl run` serves the project, over `[tool.muru.run]`.

title: muru.local.toml
